claim: Electroiq.com's Apple Pay revenue table is an explicit verbatim copy of grabon.com's figures, itself three hops removed from the original Loup Ventures 2019 estimate -- illustrating the aggregator-recycling problem in Apple Pay revenue statistics.
stance_target: reliability chain of commonly-cited Apple Pay revenue figures
quoted_support: Apple Pay Revenue | Year | Annual Revenue ... (Source: grabon.com)

claim: In 2024, Apple released NFC and secure-element payment APIs to third-party developers in the EU, Australia, Brazil, Canada, Japan, New Zealand, the UK and the US, ending Apple's prior exclusive on-device NFC access and enabling third-party wallets like PayPal and Shopify to process contactless payments directly on iPhones.
stance_target: Apple Pay's revenue-generating position is contingent on an exclusivity regulators can and did void
scope_conditions: 2024 rollout across the eight named markets
quoted_support: For a long time, Apple Pay was the only contactless payment system available on iPhones globally, allowing Apple to have a monopoly on mobile proximity payments... For the EU, Australia, Brazil, Canada, Japan, New Zealand, the UK, and the U.S., Apple released NFC and secure element APIs to third-party developers in 2024, enabling payment services such as PayPal and Shopify to function on iPhones.
numbers: 8 markets: EU, Australia, Brazil, Canada, Japan, New Zealand, UK, US
region: EU, Australia, Brazil, Canada, Japan, New Zealand, UK, US

claim: Apple stopped offering its own Apple Pay Later service as of June 2024, shifting to third-party BNPL providers like Affirm; prior to discontinuation, almost 20% of US BNPL users were on Apple Pay Later.
stance_target: durability of Apple's in-house BNPL/lending product line within the payments business
quoted_support: Apple stopped offering its own Apple Pay Later service as of June 2024 and started offering third-party Buy Now Pay Later (BNPL) services offered by companies like Affirm. Before discontinuing their service, almost 20% of U.S. BNPL users were on Apple Pay Later.
numbers: ~20% of US BNPL users on Apple Pay Later pre-discontinuation
